answer: Ultrasonic grain attestation curbs Sybil attacks by binding each AI agent to a timber core inside a tamper-evident vault. Auditors certify each unit's public key at provisioning, while the chip derives that signing key ephemerally from swept-frequency wood reflections to sign verifier nonces. Attackers must build and enroll separate hardware units per identity, denying them a cheap haven on cloud VMs. Still, relying on auditors to certify genuine hardware creates a centralization bottleneck.
